title: Jimmy Kimmel slams Trump's joke about Iranian bombing in the US
seoTitle: Kimmel slams Trump's joke about Iran
subtitle: Late-night host questions Trump's speech suggesting an Iranian attack on US cities
excerpt: Jimmy Kimmel reacted to Trump's suggestion that Iran bomb Los Angeles or San Diego, as the president continues to defend the ongoing war.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Late-night host Jimmy Kimmel commented on Donald Trump's recent remarks suggesting that Iran should bomb Los Angeles or San Diego. Kimmel treated the comments as an example of the United States' own president wishing death upon his own nation.

Other late-night hosts also addressed Trump's line of rhetoric, which emerged during a rally, where the president suggested that Iran could attack American cities. The discussion among the TV comedians revolved around Trump's continued defense of a costly war in the region.

The hosts' reactions highlight the tension generated by comments deemed inflammatory on Trump's part, as he maintains his stance of supporting the ongoing war.

With information from The Guardian.
